title: Life in Color
description: A local Aymara woman walks through the urban market, known as 16 de Julio, in El Alto, Bolivia. The city is considered one of the highest in the world, sitting at an altitude of more than 13,000 feet. The Indigenous Aymara people have lived in the Andes for thousands of years, and currently make up a majority of Bolivia's highland population.
translated_description: 一位当地的艾马拉妇女走过玻利维亚埃尔阿尔托市被称为“七月十六日”的城市市场。这座城市被认为是世界上海拔最高的城市之一，海拔超过13000英尺。艾马拉原住民在安第斯山脉生活了数千年，目前占玻利维亚高地人口的大多数。
